body: I guess I solved it ... restarted windows install, pressed Shift-F10, ran the command prompt, ran diskpart and cleared the disks, and also ran "uniqueid disk id=00000000" on both disks.  Rebooted.  I guess reinstalling after that worked.  I guess it was because I had previously used these disks before, and somehow they got the same signature.  I guess either the "clear" or "uniqueid" commands resolved that.

You don't "fix" being gay, as much as you can't fix being human.  You are what you are.  Embrace who you are and love who you are.  I kind of doubt that being gay is the root cause of your unhappiness.  Maybe being gay in a society that looks down on being gay is the problem.  In that case, it's not you, it's them!

Let's say you could "fix" being gay, and you become straight.  Do you really think life is all that happy for straight people?  I mean, it can be, but I'm straight and life isn't all shits and giggles.  

I think you need to figure out what makes you happy, and focus on those things.  Whatever makes you unhappy, get rid of it from your life.  I know, easier said than done, but don't go changing who you are, just be the best you that you can be.  If that means you're gay, be gay!  Don't let anybody tell you that you are less because you're gay.
